summary: Full backend + frontend test pass on first iteration. All 17 pytest cases green, including auth, assessment CRUD + ownership, AI story generation (first call ~15s, cached call <1s), articles, config, and leads. End-to-end UI flows verified on mobile viewport 390x844: onboarding, register, login (tom@example.com), 12-step questionnaire with every testID, report screen with headline/timeline/story-card/gap cards, Home latest story card, Learn list + article detail, Adviser lead submit (adviser-lead-success shown), Profile logout. No React Native red screens, no deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch usages found. Known: lead email_sent may be false (billing/credits), still returned 200 and lead stored - treated as acceptable per request.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking)
calc.py file is 262 lines and fine; server.py 395 lines - within limits
story endpoint returns 502 if LLM parse fails - good, but no retry; acceptable for MVP
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ users via register API during tests; one assessment auto-deleted. UI flow created 2 additional uitest_* users with 1 assessment each (not cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL in frontend/.env is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Backend uses JWT HS256 via Authorization: Bearer. Assessment IDs are Mongo ObjectIds (string in JSON). AI story takes ~15-25s first call; cached thereafter. Lead creation returns 200 with email_sent possibly false due to Resend insufficient_credits - this is expected. Full assessment flow has 12 steps for a married user with 2 kids and mortgage; use the per-step testIDs documented in /app/frontend/app/assessment.tsx. Test credentials: tom@example.com / test1234 (already has 1 cached-story assessment).
